body: Reaction chip alpha is driven by ChatReactionTransitionCoordinator: ChatReactionChipView.apply (ios/ChatModule/ChatListViewCells.swift:2228) sets 'alpha = hidesEmoji ? 0.0 : 1.0' where hidesEmoji = coordinator.isFlying(chat,message,emoji) (:2306). Any flight that never calls finishFlight — cell recycled, window gone, animation completion dropped — leaves the chip permanently at alpha 0 / the strip looking half-faded. Suspect #1 for the reported 'reaction causes a slight cell opacity issue'.
author: Vibe Team
